source_preview:
Job Description: Technical Delivery Manager (IT
Infrastructure & Cloud)
Experience: 5 to 10 Years
Qualification: BE/BTech/MCA/BSc-IT (PG/MBA preferred but not mandatory)
Certifications (Good to Have): ITIL, PMP / PRINCE2
Role Summary:
We are looking for a Technical Delivery Manager with strong understanding of IT Infrastructure,
Cloud, Database, Middleware, and OS Administration to manage end-to-end project delivery,
ensure operational excellence, and drive customer satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities:
• Manage complete technical project delivery and ensure adherence to scope, timelines, and
quality.
• Coordinate with teams handling Infrastructure, DBA, Middleware, Cloud, and Application Support.
• Handle resource planning, task allocation, and team performance tracking.
• Monitor project risks, escalations, SLA compliance, and issue resolution.
• Engage with clients/stakeholders for requirement gathering, reporting, and delivery updates.
• Ensure smooth execution of support and implementation activities across multiple technologies.
• Prepare project documentation, MIS reports, and delivery dashboards.
• Drive process improvements and implement IT service delivery best practices.
Required Skills:
• Strong understanding of IT Infrastructure (Windows/Linux), Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), DBA
(Oracle/MySQL/MongoDB), Middleware (WebLogic/Tomcat/JBoss), and Networking basics.
• Experience managing IT service delivery / technical operations / support projects.
• Good communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
• Ability to manage multiple projects and handle escalations effectively.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
• Proven experience in managing delivery teams (L1/L2/L3).
• Exposure to ITSM processes and SLA-based delivery models.
• Strong analytical and reporting skills.
